title: Design System: runly.pos
scope: Only inside the POS module (apps/desktop/src/modules/runly.pos), applied by PosThemeScope via the .pos-theme class on the screen root and on body while mounted. The rest of Runly ERP keeps its own system.

narrative.overview:
This system covers only the point of sale module (apps/desktop/src/modules/runly.pos). It is applied by PosThemeScope, which wraps every POS screen in .pos-theme and puts the same class on body while a POS screen is mounted, so portaled dialogs, menus and toasts match. Every other ERP screen keeps the ERP's own system; nothing here applies outside that scope.

The POS reads as a business register, not a consumer app: a squared, gridded surface where 1px rules separate the panels, the product grid shares its cell borders, and the charge path is the strongest object on screen. Light theme is a cool grey-white ground with white panels, dark navy ink and a navy band; dark theme is blue-black with graphite panels and grey-white ink. Runly logo orange is reserved for action and selection. The signature is the customer-display band: the total (and the change) sits on a navy band (black in dark) in large tabular figures under a short orange caption, the way a register's customer display reads.

The owner pinned this direction on 2026-11-04 (enterprise and square, not pastel; Runly logo colours; light = orange with dark navy, dark = white/grey with orange; operating screens full screen with their own bar). PRODUCT.md's earlier brand note asks for "friendly and soft rather than harsh"; the build follows the later pin, and the softness lives in plain copy and generous touch sizes, not in rounded pastel shapes. The concept roll was skipped because the owner pinned the direction.
keyCharacteristics: Scoped identity: `.pos-theme` only, light and dark (follows the app's `.dark` class).
Squared corners (3-10px), 1px hairline rules, ruled product grid.
Orange only for action and selection, always with dark ink on it.
Customer-display band for the figure the cashier reads out.
Tabular numerals everywhere in the scope.
Opaque surfaces: no glass, blur or brand glow.

rules.name: The Dark Ink On Orange Rule
rules.body: Text and icons on any orange fill use the orange ink token, never white.

rules.name: The Orange Means Act Rule
rules.body: Orange appears only on things you press or things that are selected. Decorative orange, orange headings and orange panels are out.

rules.name: The Muted Disabled Rule
rules.body: A disabled orange control turns to the muted fill with muted text at full opacity, never a washed-out orange.

rules.name: The Figures Align Rule
rules.body: Every money figure is tabular and bold where it is the thing being read.

rules.name: The Caption Belongs To The Band Rule
rules.body: Uppercase tracked text exists only as the band's caption, directly beside its figure. It is not a section label or eyebrow anywhere else.

rules.name: The Opaque Surface Rule
rules.body: No blur, glass, tint or brand glow on any POS surface; a dialog is a card.

dos: **Do** wrap every POS screen in `PosThemeScope` so dialogs and toasts inherit the scope through `body.pos-theme`.
**Do** put dark orange ink on every orange fill (6.1:1), never white (3.6:1).
**Do** reserve orange for actions and selection; show the figure the cashier reads out on the navy band with an orange caption.
**Do** separate regions with 1px hairlines and keep corners within 3-10px.
**Do** keep controls at 44px and primary actions at 56px.
**Do** keep the success, danger and warning tones from the shared `@runly/ui` components.
donts: **Don't** apply these tokens outside the POS module; the rest of Runly ERP keeps its own system.
**Don't** use glass, blur, tint or glow on POS surfaces.
**Don't** use pastel fills for chips, pills or mode tiles; state is an outline or a solid action fill.
**Don't** fade a disabled orange control; switch it to the muted fill.
**Don't** use uppercase tracked labels as eyebrows or section labels; the band caption is the only one.
**Don't** mark the selected side-menu row with a coloured side stripe.

openItems: Success toast keeps the shared component's coloured left bar: layered !important utilities in the shared toaster outrank the scoped override in pos-theme.css. Not canonized.
Concept roll skipped: the owner pinned the direction on 2026-11-04 (seed: none).
Floor planner keeps pre-identity rounded-full shapes (glass status pill in FloorPlannerStage, selection dot and badge in FloorPropertiesPanel). Not canonized, not repaired.
